title: User Authentication
description: The system must provide secure user authentication allowing users to log in with email and password credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-0001: Valid credentials grant access to the application
AC-0002: Invalid credentials display appropriate error message
AC-0003: Account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts
AC-0005: Remember me functionality persists session
AC-0006: Forgot password flow sends reset email
nonFunctionalRequirements: Session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity
author: Test Design Agent
